title: US Barriers on Drones and Robots May Redirect Competition, Not End It
dek: As the U.S. restricts more foreign-made drones and robots, China’s manufacturing scale could shift the competitive fight to markets beyond American borders.
socialCaption: The U.S. is tightening barriers around foreign-made drones and robots. China’s manufacturing scale means the competitive impact may be felt less in production than in where companies choose to sell, scale and set standards.
